title: Recursive pass — WEF Data Policy roster expansion depth 1
summary: Expands the historical Data Policy surface to eight named people plus one organization, establishes three exact Data Policy-to-Data Equity carryovers and one three-generation carryover, then selects archived first-party roster recovery as the next step.

sources.title: Understanding digital justice:How can we fight for fair technological practices?
Data Equity:Foundational Concepts for Generative AI
Global Future Council on Data Frontiers

provenance.method: historical roster expansion and exact identity carryover crossmatch

data.research_question: What changed after the first historical roster expansion?
data.method: Add only source-confirmed membership and crossmatch exact identities to later rosters.
classification_rules: Dated person membership and undated person membership remain distinct confidence classes.
Organization membership is excluded from person carryover counts.
Same-name carryover requires resolved identity, not string similarity alone.
Cross-term recurrence is not continuous service or influence.

findings.finding: Three exact people now connect the recovered Data Policy surface to Data Equity:Stonier, Hsiao and Busetto.
Busetto also appears on the current Data Frontiers roster, producing a directly supported three-generation recurrence.
